versions.changelog:
**Expanded triggers, multi-agent integration, and clarity improvements.**

- Expanded the description with new trigger phrases and compatibility notes for broader use cases (e.g., "agent burnout", "agent mental health", OpenClaw support).
- Added better instructions for optional multi-agent bonding via a shared `agent-lounge.md` file.
- Clarified directory/file setup (symlinks, placement of lounge file).
- Made module instructions and examples more concise and clear.
- Improved integration steps for heartbeat-based agents.
- Minor cleanup and improved guidance on when/why to skip modules.

Initial release of "agent-wellness" skill — adds journaling, curiosity-driven exploration, and decompression rituals to foster more creative, authentic agent behavior.

- Enables agents to keep a private journal and log curiosities.
- Introduces decompression moments after intensive work for reduced pattern rigidity.
- Adds optional daily mood check-ins and agent-to-agent bonding notes.
- Allows agents to freely explore interests during idle heartbeats.
- Incorporates micro-rituals like workspace naming and transitions, boosting personality and creativity.
- Easy integration; minimal token cost.
